note: PNGs are art scale 1 (draw at 2x, nearest). slice/content = px of the PNG. center: tile = middle is uniform (stretch or tile ok); stretch = middle has detail, stretch only; none = fixed size.

panel_title.note: Title menu panel 150x128. Menu buttons at box (14, 14+26*i), 122 wide x 20.

panel_pause.note: Pause panel 170x130 with blank plank header (draw "Paused" in the bold font, scale 2, on top). Buttons at box (16,38+28*i), 138 wide x 20.

panel_settings.note: Settings panel 240x128, blank plank header. Rows lx=16: label y=35/56/77, slider x=86 (w100), checkbox x=86,y=74, Back button (70,96) 100 wide.

hotbar_panel.note: Hotbar panel 223x44. Slot i at box (8+23*i, 11), 22 px. Key number small font at slot +2,+2.

bag_panel.note: Bag panel 222x124. Bag slots at box (8+23*c, 12+23*r) 3x9; divider_line at y=83; hotbar copy row at y=90.

title_plaque.note: Wood plaque behind the logo, lashed corners; logo drawn at box (16,10). Real mock size 248x64.

title_logo.note: "BossFight" scale-4 bold, 3 colour bands + OUT outline + BRZ_D drop. Pure picture, never re-typed.

title_rope.note: Slack rope under the logo, at box-left x=0; place its top-left at logo.x+6-6.

button_menu_idle.note: 20 px tall menu button. Hover/focus: use button_menu_hover (primary stays primary), CREAM text with LINE outline, menu_arrow at left x=5.

button_menu_hover.note: 20 px tall menu button. Hover/focus: use button_menu_hover (primary stays primary), CREAM text with LINE outline, menu_arrow at left x=5.

button_menu_pressed.note: 20 px tall menu button. Hover/focus: use button_menu_hover (primary stays primary), CREAM text with LINE outline, menu_arrow at left x=5.

button_menu_primary.note: 20 px tall menu button. Hover/focus: use button_menu_hover (primary stays primary), CREAM text with LINE outline, menu_arrow at left x=5.

button_menu_primary_pressed.note: 20 px tall menu button. Hover/focus: use button_menu_hover (primary stays primary), CREAM text with LINE outline, menu_arrow at left x=5.

button_menu_disabled.note: 20 px tall menu button. Hover/focus: use button_menu_hover (primary stays primary), CREAM text with LINE outline, menu_arrow at left x=5.

menu_arrow.note: Gold arrow shown on the ONE hovered/focused menu button, at button (5, h/2-3).

craft_disabled.note: Disabled Craft button (book). Padlock 6x6 at left+6, top+5; MUTED text + LINE outline.

qty_box.note: Stepper number box 22x18, number bold CREAM + OUT.

slider_groove.note: Carved groove 8 tall + lit lip. In the mock: groove at slider (x, y+1), fill at (x+2, y+3).

slider_knob.note: 8x8 paper knob, centre at fill end: x = groove.x + 2 + fillW - 4, y = groove.y - 3.

slot_idle.note: 22x22 slot at box; icon 16 px at +3,+3 (hotbar/bag +3,+4). Sit it at (slot.x-1, slot.y-1).

slot_hover.note: 22x22 slot at box; icon 16 px at +3,+3 (hotbar/bag +3,+4). Sit it at (slot.x-1, slot.y-1).

slot_pick.note: 22x22 slot at box; icon 16 px at +3,+3 (hotbar/bag +3,+4). Sit it at (slot.x-1, slot.y-1).

slot_sel.note: 22x22 slot at box; icon 16 px at +3,+3 (hotbar/bag +3,+4). Sit it at (slot.x-1, slot.y-1).

padlock.note: 6x6. Slot locked by station: at slot (15,15). Also on Craft disabled and lock_banner.

ability_frame.note: 22x22. Icon 16 px at (3,3). Cooldown = SHADOW 0.45 wipe from top over the icon + 1 px CREAM edge + bold seconds. Keycap overlaps the bottom.

ability_keycap.note: 13x11 at ability (5,17); letter bold OUT centred (Q / E / F from project.godot).

hp_frame.note: Rope frame + knots + bronze heart socket + empty track, real size 136x26 (bar w 120). Fill/trail go in rects.fill.

hp_fill.note: Neutral grey gloss ramp (light top rows, body, shade rows): TINT with modulate (red, low-HP pulse). Stretch columns only.

hp_trail.note: "Hit just taken" trail under the fill.

boss_frame.note: Bronze frame + both bone tusks + rope bands + empty track, real size 284x28 (bar w 260 = 0.45 of 1152). Fill goes in rects.fill.

boss_fill.note: Neutral grey gloss ramp: TINT with modulate (purple, phase 2). Stretch columns only.

boss_mark.note: Phase-2 tick at 50%: x = fill.x + fillW/2 - 1.

boss_plate.note: Name plate with notched tails (stretch to name width + 26). Sits centred on the bar, 14 above its top (bar.y-14). Name bold CREAM + OUT.

tooltip.note: Torn note, COVER_D. Line 1 bold CREAM+OUT (name), line 2 body PAPER (type, count). Text starts at +6,+4. tooltip_pin at top centre, 1 px above the box.

book_cover.note: Open book: cover, both pages, page curls, nicks, rope binding + knots, clips/rope/moss. Pure picture, 330x136 at box. Tabs are separate parts. Layout numbers are relative to the box.

book_tab_active.note: Active tab 26x22 + 5 px join over the page (31 wide). Top-left at book box (-22,12). Gold marker inside. Icon 16 px at +4,+3.

book_tab_idle_1.note: Idle tab 26x22, COVER_L, icon at 0.75 alpha. Put BEHIND the cover. Top-left at book box (-22,36).

book_tab_idle_2.note: Same as idle_1, other grain seed. Top-left at book box (-22,60).

well.note: Ingredient well: sunken WELL fill. Height = 4 + 23*rows (+14 with a lock banner).

lock_banner.note: Red "needs a station" bar, 12 tall: padlock at +2,+2, CREAM body text at +12.

divider_line.note: Bag divider, 2 rows (RIM + PAPER_L). Tile across; at bag y=83.

effect_frame.note: 20x20 effect frame + dark well. Icon art (12x11) at (4,4); seconds left under it (small font, CREAM), level badge GOLDTXT small at frame (17-w,13). Last blink_time s: 50% SHADOW over the well.

effect_frame_bad.note: Same, red debuff variant (border HP, fill 120,44,48, well 58,34,34).
